# Shyan Yee | Malaysia Luxury Properties & Landmark Residences Portal

> shyanyee.com is the property portal of Yee Woei Shyan ("Shyan Yee"), REN 46305, Senior Real Estate Negotiator with IQI Realty Sdn Bhd (E(1)1584), Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It lists 69 new-launch and landmark residential projects across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Johor Bahru and Penang with developer pricing, floor plans, comparisons, an interactive map, mortgage calculators, buyer guides and FAQs. Not a developer website.

## Guides & articles (15)

- [The Ultimate Guide to Foreigner Property Ownership in Malaysia (2026)](https://shyanyee.com/blog/foreigner-buying-property-in-malaysia): Learn everything about how foreigners buy freehold/leasehold properties in Malaysia. Minimum thresholds, State Consent processes, taxes, visa options, and hidde
- [Singaporean Buyer's Companion: How to Secure Malaysian Secondary Assets](https://shyanyee.com/blog/singaporean-buying-property-in-malaysia): The absolute guide for Singaporeans purchasing property in Johor Bahru or Kuala Lumpur. ABSD guidelines, CPF savings limits, and cash flow structures.
- [Johor Bahru RTS Link Ultimate Guide: Impact on Property & Commuter Times](https://shyanyee.com/blog/rts-johor-bahru-guide): Learn how the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link will transform Johor Bahru and Singapore connectivity. Find out which condominium developments benefit the most.
- [Johor Property Market Outlook 2026: Boom or Speculation?](https://shyanyee.com/blog/johor-property-market-outlook): An in-depth empirical study of the Johor real estate boom. Analyzing Special Economic Zones (JS-SEZ), tax incentives, and the latest transaction volumes.
- [Malaysia Property Investment: Strategies for High Yield & Capital Gains](https://shyanyee.com/blog/malaysia-property-investment-guide): The professional investor guide to maximizing real estate returns in Malaysia. Leverage, localization, tax setups, and high-performance properties.
- [Freehold vs Leasehold: Which is the Smarter Buy in Malaysia?](https://shyanyee.com/blog/freehold-vs-leasehold): An in-depth empirical comparison of Freehold versus Leasehold properties. Financial cost differences, title transfer processes, and heritage protections.
- [Foreigner Home Loan Guide: Navigating Malaysian Banks](https://shyanyee.com/blog/foreign-buyer-home-loan-guide-malaysia): The step-by-step financial workbook for securing home loan financing in Malaysia as a non-resident. LTV ratios, interest rates, and document checking.
- [Top 5 High-Demand Areas to Purchase Property in Malaysia](https://shyanyee.com/blog/best-areas-to-buy-property-in-malaysia): An in-depth geopolitical study ranking the top real estate growth hubs in Malaysia: KLCC, Mont Kiara, Bukit Jalil, JB Central, and Bangsar.
- [Demystifying Malaysian Property Taxes: A Guide for Foreigners](https://shyanyee.com/blog/malaysia-property-taxes-explained): Understand the tax structures surrounding estate investments in Malaysia. We break down MOT, quit rent, assessment tax, RPGT, and rental income tax.
- [Is Johor Bahru Property a Wise Investment in 2026?](https://shyanyee.com/blog/is-johor-property-a-good-investment): An objective investment analysis of Johor Bahru properties. Evaluating price history, RTS infrastructure progress, and Special Economic Zone triggers.
- [Kuala Lumpur vs. Johor Bahru: Which Property Market Wins for Your Portfolio? (2026)](https://shyanyee.com/blog/kl-vs-jb-property-market-comparison): An in-depth comparative masterclass analyzing price performance, rental demographics, liquidity profiles, and capital growth metrics for KL and JB.
- [How the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ) Reshapes Land Values (2026)](https://shyanyee.com/blog/js-sez-impact-on-johor-property): An in-depth look at the newly established Special Economic Zone, its harmonized tax structures, and its direct multiplier effect on residential prices.
- [Decoding the MM2H 2026 Guidelines: Platinum, Gold, and Silver Tiers Analyzed](https://shyanyee.com/blog/mm2h-2026-guidelines-comprehensive-guide): A professional walkthrough of the revised Malaysia My Second Home requirements, fixed deposit thresholds, and property acquisition options.
- [Understanding Property Maintenance Fees & Sinking Funds in Malaysian Condos](https://shyanyee.com/blog/understanding-maintenance-fees-sinking-funds): Avoid surprise charges. Learn how share units determine your monthly service fees, what sinking funds cover, and how to assess management quality.
- [Evaluating Rental Yields: Standard Long-Term Tenants vs. AirBnB Homestays in Malaysia](https://shyanyee.com/blog/rental-yield-long-term-vs-short-term-airbnb): A transparent mathematical comparison of cash flows, operational overheads, management costs, and final net returns for residential assets.
